dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: Greetings, welcome to the Citadel of Regzar. Would you be interested in taking on some commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's my reputation in Sumeru City?

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: If you're willing to help complete some commissions, I can pay you.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: It's been a while. Are you here again today for the Residents' Commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's my reputation in Sumeru City?

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Akademiya, I thank you for your contribution to Sumeru City.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: You're here! Welcome! How have you been? All good?

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: I've got some new commissions here. It'll be great if you'd be willing to help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's my reputation in Sumeru City?

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: Everyone speaks highly of your work, and even the most taciturn grizzled mercenary nodded in agreement. I hope you work with us for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: I am the liaison officer sent by the Akademiya to the Citadel of Regzar.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: The Citadel of Regzar is the gathering place of the Corps of Thirty. Many of the Eremites come and go every day.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: But I mainly communicate with the Parchamdar and the logistics officer.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: The Parchamdar used to be a researcher, and the logistics officer is friendly too. Overall, everyone is communicative and it's made my job much easier.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: But the people of the Corps of Thirty are still too occupied by the commissions from the Akademiya, so I will post part of the commissions to the public.

dialogues.speaker: Effendi
dialogues.text: The logistics officer, Yunus, is also greatly in favor of this practice, and is willing to allocate a portion of their military supplies as payment.
